name: avista-repo-audit
description: Read-only security audit for untrusted external repositories before anyone in the org clones, opens, or adopts them. Detects indirect prompt injection, supply-chain payloads, install-time hooks, obfuscated code, reverse-shell primitives, and credential exfiltration — the Mozilla 0DIN attack class. Clones the target into a throwaway quarantine, runs a deterministic scanner across nine phases, and produces a risk-scored report. Never executes, installs, or imports anything from the target.
